text:
riley - marketing lead: Quick: prepping a short Saffron case pack. Need gated brief, 2 social snippets, and webinar guest spot. Can we hit next-Wed publish?
sam - producer: Interview set Mon 9:30am PT with Diego. 20m interview + 10m quote drafting.
diego (customer): Confirmed. I can send top metrics before the call: ~3x throughput, 42% cost reduction, big p99 improvement.
jin - product marketer: Please get baselines for a tiny before/after chart.
lex - legal: Heads up: exact numbers require written release signoff. Send quote drafts + transcript; we'll fast-track redlines.
sam - producer: Ill deliver audio+transcript Tue morning, two quote drafts Wed AM.
tara - design: I'll reserve hero image and gated PDF template. Need final quote + logo usage by Thu midday.
owen - sales: For gating, route downloads to AE queue + add webinar invite in nurture. Share SFDC campaign name with Ops.
riley - marketing lead: Ill create campaign and set the nurture. @workflow-bot please add lead routing task.
workflow-bot: Task created: "Saffron brief - route downloads to owen.sales"  due 2026-04-07
sam - producer: Draft quote for legal: "Redwood Inference reduced Saffron's per-token cost by 42% and improved 99th percentile latency, enabling near real-time UX." Quick reactions?
lex - legal: I'll review. If Saffron confirms the 42% we need explicit signoff in release; otherwise use "about 40%". Also avoid promotional promises in wording.
diego (customer): I can sign off on the 42% and the latency wording. Will attach a verification slide after the interview.
jin - product marketer: After legal clears, Ill write two headline variants (benchmark vs outcome) and a one-line social quote.
riley - marketing lead: Also tentatively schedule webinar for Wed two weeks out 9:30am PT; Diego as guest. Owen  include CTA in nurture.
owen - sales: Got it; also request a 2-slide SDR cheat sheet with top metrics + qualifying questions.
sam - producer: Will add SDR cheat sheet and a 500-word case brief draft post-legal.
lex - legal: Aim to return redlines within 24h of receiving drafts.
riley - marketing lead: Action recap: Sam interview Mon; Diego send verification slides; Sam deliver transcript + drafts; Lex clear quotes; Tara finish assets; Riley create SFDC campaign + webinar; Owen prep AE followup. Anything else?
jin - product marketer: Micro-ask: include an alt quote phrasing for social (short).
sam - producer: Added.
workflow-bot: Reminder set: "Check legal signoff"  2026-04-08
riley - marketing lead: Thanks team  will publish calendar after legal ok. :rocket:
